title: ProjectSync
tagline: An autonomous Taskmaster AI Agent that turns shipped GitHub code into career assets in one click.
highlights: Engineered a 7-Node Directed Acyclic Graph agent workflow with Google ADK 2.0 and Google GenAI
Implemented a dual-layer memory system with Semantic Style Rules and an Episodic Transaction Ledger
Designed an Adaptive Curator Agent featuring human-in-the-loop style learning and dual-commit callbacks
Deployed a stateless backend container on Google Cloud Run connected to Google Cloud Firestore for state storage
